problems.note: Cross-face: starts on F1 (f1-white-edge, f1-white-big, START tags per F1 labeller), then F8 (f8-white-mid logo hold, f8-white-top curved pair). FINISH tag beside f9-white-top: fairly confident it is the finish. f9-white-low (floor, no tag) is a guess as a foot; it is very likely the same physical hold as F1's f1-white-bottom-edge (seen obliquely from F1) - keep only one when merging.

START tag on the black crescent: confident start. Rest is a guess: crescent -> arete dot -> big black on the F9/F1 arete -> small black crimps, with grey arete feet. Probably also uses F8's unassigned f8-black-right / f8-black-low and F1's jawa-black-f1-a holds (f1-black-left-arete, f1-black-low-edge), which the F1 labeller said likely belong to an F9 black line - consider merging jawa-black-f1-a into this.
